data.name: Touch of Glory
data.description: You can cause your hand to shimmer with divine radiance, allowing you to touch a creature as a standard action and give it a +%1 bonus to a single Charisma-based skill check or Charisma ability check. This ability lasts for one hour or until the creature touched elects to apply the bonus to a roll. You can use this ability to grant the bonus %2 times per day.|DomainGloryLVL|TouchofGloryTimes
